company_name: Japan Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, Laboratory on Next-Generation S
semiconductor_relevance: Low — The laboratory's focus is primarily on photovoltaic solar cells, which are not directly part of the semiconductor manufacturing value chain.
summary: The Japan Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, Laboratory on Next-Generation S, specializes in the research and development of next-generation solar cells. Their work includes the formation of polycrystalline silicon thin films, catalytic chemical vapor deposition, and studying voltage-induced degradation in solar cells. They offer processing and measurement services and engage in collaborative research with industry partners.
capabilities: Formation of polycrystalline silicon thin films using flash lamp annealing
Application of catalytic chemical vapor deposition (Cat-CVD) in solar cell manufacturing
Study of voltage-induced degradation in crystalline silicon solar cell modules
Processing and measurement services for solar cell research
